Listen to 9to5Mac's curated daily headline news recap for you. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and the Apple Podcasts app, Stitcher, TuneIn, and Google Play, and you can also listen via our dedicated RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you clear all the clutter from your mind, organizing it into a simple and elegant system—clearing unfinished items and reducing mental stress. A simple to-do list designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, paired with powerful tools, makes the process of organizing, tracking, and checking off tasks more satisfying. So you can get things done one by one.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every Monday through Friday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to ensure new episodes are delivered to your ears as soon as they're released.

The news discussed in this episode:

  • Apple releases iOS 27.0.1 for iPhone, here's a look at the new features
  • Leak reveals unreleased new iPhone Duo feature
  • iOS 27 brings three important new features to Find My
  • Apple releases macOS 27.0.1, macOS 26.7.1, and macOS 15.8.1
